Title: Show batch progress and candidates in History
Description: As a desktop user, I want to see the progress of uploaded batches and the candidates they produced so that I can track extraction results. The History screen polls GET /batches and GET /batches/{id}/results, displaying the saga stage (Ingested, Extracted, Scored, Harvested, Seeded) and a candidate list with linked knowledge items and source locations.
AcceptanceCriteria: History screen polls GET /collector/batches to list all user's batches
Batch list shows batch_id, batch_name, created_at, and current saga stage
Clicking a batch fetches candidates from GET /collector/batches/{id}/results
Candidate list shows title, kind, evidence count, score, and patentability
Clicking a candidate shows linked knowledge item and source location (page/lines)
Source location is clickable and opens the original file in local editor if available
UI auto-updates every 5 seconds while batches are in progress
End-to-end check: upload a batch, monitor stages in History, verify candidates appear
All code for this story lives inside Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector; nothing in services/, contracts/, frontend/ or deploy/ is edited or referenced (outside logic is re-implemented inside)
TalkingPoints: Building the History screen to poll batch status and display candidates with their linked knowledge and source locations. Auto-refresh every 5 seconds. Full end-to-end integration with the extraction results API.
